# Medishelf - Pharmacy Inventory & POS Software Overview

Medishelf (https://medishelf.co) is modern, cloud-based pharmacy inventory management and Point of Sale (POS) billing software purpose-built for independent community pharmacies, retail drugstores, and medical shops.

## Core Modules & Pages

- `/` (Home): Landing page highlighting batch tracking, FEFO billing, and counter speed.
- `/features`: Deep dive into product management, lot tracking, POS, RBAC, loyalty, reports, and security.
- `/inventory`: Dedicated pharmacy inventory management, batch/expiry alerts, receiving, and stock movement logs.
- `/sales`: High-speed keyboard-driven POS terminal with barcode scanning and split payments.
- `/pricing`: One simple plan at $49/month with every feature included.
- `/casestudy`: Real-world case studies showing 62% reduction in drug expiry waste and fast onboarding.
- `/demo`: Free trial signup (no credit card required).
- `/aboutus`: Company mission and pharmacist-first engineering values.
- `/contact`: Sales and customer support inquiries.
- `/blog`: Educational articles on pharmaceutical inventory control, FEFO picking, and medical store management.

## Legal & Compliance
- `/legal`: Trust Center hub linking every policy, security and support page.
- `/privacy`: Privacy Policy and HIPAA-ready data isolation standards.
- `/tmc`: Terms and Conditions.
- `/refundPolicy`: 30-day money-back guarantee and data export policy.
- `/cookie-policy`: Full list of cookies (essential, Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity) and opt-out options.
- `/acceptable-use`: Acceptable Use Policy for pharmacies and staff.
- `/disclaimer`: Content is not medical, legal, regulatory or tax advice; how to read case studies.

## Trust & Help
- `/faq`: Categorized FAQ on setup, inventory, POS, pricing, data/security and support.
- `/support`: Support channels, response targets by severity, 99.9% uptime target.
- `/security`: Tenant isolation, TLS 1.3 / AES-256 encryption, bcrypt, audit logs, incident response, vulnerability disclosure.
- `/editorial-policy`: How blog guides are researched, fact-checked, updated and corrected.
- `/accessibility`: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility statement and feedback route.

## Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Search & SEO: Schema.org structured data (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList), XML Sitemap, and automated dynamic robots.
